WITH patient_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
        AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS avg_hgb_hct_ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
ratio_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_hgb_hct_ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM patient_stats
)
SELECT
    ps.ID,
    ps.SEX,
    ps.avg_wbc,
    ps.avg_hgb_hct_ratio AS ratio,
    ps.avg_hgb_hct_ratio - rm.mean_ratio AS ratio_minus_mean
FROM patient_stats AS ps
CROSS JOIN ratio_mean AS rm
WHERE ps.avg_hgb_hct_ratio > rm.mean_ratio
ORDER BY ratio_minus_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
